Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a couple of procurement questions we discussed on the call:

- We loved the performance demos; main stakeholders are Procurement and AP (I'm CC'ing them separately).
- Our AP policy requires a PO for any vendor onboarding > $10,000/year. Otherwise we can pay by corporate card.

Can Redwood accept a PO? If so what paperwork does your procurement team need (order form, W-9, vendor questionnaire, etc.)? Also, do you support marketplace purchases (ours prefers AWS Marketplace for consolidated billing)?

Sarah —

Great to meet you today. Appreciate the clear outline of your AP constraints. Short recap and next steps from our side: 

1) Payment methods: Redwood supports both corporate card and PO-based billing. For PO customers we generally require a signed order form and an invoice schedule.
2) Vendor onboarding: Typical docs our finance team requests are a filled vendor questionnaire, W-9 (for US entities), and the signed order form. If you need any other compliance artifacts (SOC 2 report, data processing addendum), we can share those as well.
3) Marketplace: We are available on AWS Marketplace in some regions; if consolidated billing through marketplace is a strict requirement we can confirm availability for your account/region.

Attachments: Redwood_order_form.docx (draft order form), vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (checklist for your AP).

Proposed next steps: 
- I'll send the order form (attached) and the vendor onboarding checklist for your AP to review.
- Lauren (CC) can confirm any specifics around our vendor setup and typical timelines.
- If a PO is the path you prefer, please share your procurement contact and any vendor portal instructions (Coupa, Ariba, etc.).

Typical timing: if all docs are in order, vendor setup + PO issuance usually takes 2-4 weeks; if your AP needs more time we can discuss interim short-term card payment to get started.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah / Marissa —

Looping in Redwood Finance to clarify vendor onboarding requirements and timelines. From experience with similar customers, here's what AP typically needs for a PO-based setup:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (I've attached our standard checklist).
- W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN for non-US entities.
- Signed order form / SOW with billing address and remit-to details.
- Any required tax forms or payment terms documentation.

If you're using a marketplace (AWS Marketplace), billing onboarding is usually faster but sometimes impacts how we apply discounts and billing terms. Tell us if AWS Marketplace is required and we'll confirm availability for your account.

If time is sensitive, we can provision short-term access on a corporate card while the PO is processed — we've done that for a few pilots. If you prefer that route, let me know the card-holder and approximate spend cap so Finance can approve.

I'm adding the internal links below for the order form (DocuSign) and the HubSpot deal so we can track the procurement milestone.

Thanks —
